as_told.title: Pentagon 'super user' briefing on compartmented programs had nothing about UFOs

plain: Eric Haseltine, a former director of research at the NSA, says he never saw any sign of a programme to reverse-engineer UFOs, that is, to take apart recovered craft and copy their technology. He tells Michels he had access to a great deal, and that as a 'super user' he once had to sit through a full day at the Pentagon being shown compartmented programs, secret projects open only to named people, which he likens to the eye-clamping scene in A Clockwork Orange. He says he remembers none of it, but there was nothing about UFOs. It is a first-hand account from an insider that cuts against claims of a hidden recovery programme.
